name: Shadow Ragnarok
description: A stamina-type demon that feeds on punishment. Every blow it absorbs charges shadow energy into its spinning layers — unleashed all at once in a devastating dark burst.

ability.name: Shadow Accumulation
ability.description: Each time Shadow Ragnarok takes damage before its Special, it stores Shadow Stacks (max 5). On Special, each stack adds +20 bonus damage and heals 10 HP. After detonation all stacks are consumed. Additionally, the Special grants +25 ATK for 2 turns.

special_move.name: Ragnarok Shadowfall
special_move.description: Shadow Ragnarok detonates all stored darkness in a crushing 3-hit eclipse strike — power scales with every wound it has endured!
flavour_texts: 🌑 **Ragnarok Shadowfall** — the darkness erupts into a three-hit annihilation!
